procedure_text: (1)原料2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯在碱性物质存在下于三级醇溶剂中发生酯解反应得到2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐； (1)原料2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯在碱性物质存在下于三级醇溶剂中发生酯解反应，25～40℃反应5～12h，得到2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐，相对于1mol所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯，所述三级醇溶剂的用量为700～3500mL，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯与碱性物质的摩尔比为1:(1～1.1)；
procedure_summary: The benzoate ester starting material is treated with a basic substance in a tertiary alcohol solvent, cleaving the methyl ester to the alkali metal benzoate salt and leaving the benzylic bromide in place. The claims state no workup, no isolation and no yield for the salt.
notes: Claim preamble: 1.一种2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法，其特征在于，包括步骤如下： (line 43). This is step (1) of the claimed process, recited twice: claim 1 states it without conditions (line 45) and claim 10 restates it with the temperature, the time and the ratios (line 110). procedure_text carries both recitations verbatim, in that order, because neither contains the other and rule 30 asks for the procedure unabridged. reaction_class: the patent calls the transformation an ester cleavage and the product is the alkali metal carboxylate, so hydrolysis is the closest class on the allowed list. Confidence is medium, not high, because with an anhydrous base such as a hydride or the free metal in a tertiary alcohol no water need be present, so the cleavage is not strictly a hydrolysis; ester_formation would be the reverse reaction and salt_formation alone would drop the ester cleavage that the claim actually recites. named_reaction is left null rather than stretched: saponification would fit only the hydroxide options and not the hydride, alkoxide or metal ones. The benzylic bromide is untouched, which is the point of the step, but the claim does not discuss that selectivity so selectivity stays null. All eight basic substances of claim 3 and all three tertiary alcohols of claim 2 are listed in compounds[] although only one of each would be charged; this follows the reference run, which listed every claimed solvent alternative on one record. The generic classes the claim is written in, basic substance and tertiary alcohol, are not compound records, so their enumerations are carried here and in molar_ratio_text. Claim 3 lists sodium metal and potassium metal as basic substances for a reaction run in a tertiary alcohol. In that case the base actually acting would be the tertiary alkoxide formed in situ from the solvent, which the claim does not say. Recorded, not resolved. Numbers that the schema cannot hold: equivalents is null because claim 3 gives the ester to base ratio only as a range; time_h is null because claim 4 and claim 10 give the time only as a range, which a single float cannot carry, and the range is in molar_ratio_text and the provenance sidecar; concentration.value and concentration.reagent are null because claim 3 gives a mass concentration range for two different hydroxides, so only the text field can hold it. Being a process claim, no charge, no yield, no reactor, no workup, no purification and no in-process control is stated anywhere for this step, and that absence is not flagged. Methanol is liberated by the cleavage but the claims never name or recover it, so there is no by-product record. This section contains no drawn scheme.

procedure_text: (2)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应或者将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应，得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。 (2)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应，或者将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与醇的摩尔比为1:(1.05～1.35)，与碱性物质的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)，所述2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐的摩尔比为1:(1.2～1.5)，反应时间3～6h，反应温度为-5～15℃，经脱溶、水稀释、酸化、过滤和烘干后得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。
procedure_summary: The benzoate salt from the preceding step is etherified at the benzylic position, either by an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance or by a preformed alkali metal alkoxide, in a polar aprotic solvent in the cold. The solvent is removed, the residue is diluted with water and acidified with hydrochloric acid, and the alkoxymethyl benzoic acid is filtered off and dried.
notes: Step (2) of the claimed process, recited by claim 1 (line 47) and restated with ratios, time, temperature and workup by claim 10 (line 112); procedure_text carries both verbatim, in that order, for the same reason as step 1. One record, not two, although the claim offers two reagent systems for the same transformation: the benzoate salt with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or the benzoate salt with a preformed alkali metal alkoxide. Both displace the benzylic bromide and both give the same product, so they are alternatives within one step, and every alternative reagent is listed in compounds[]. reaction_class is nucleophilic_substitution and the named reaction is the Williamson ether synthesis. ACIDIFICATION, an internal tension recorded and not resolved: claim 1 has step (2) give the free benzoic acid directly, while claim 8 states that it is the acidification with hydrochloric acid to pH 2 to 3 after the reaction that gives the acid, and claim 10 lists acidification among the post-reaction operations. The immediate product of the substitution is the carboxylate, not the acid, so the two recitations do not agree about what step (2) ends with. The acidification is recorded as a workup operation, with hydrochloric acid in compounds[] with role acid, and the product is the acid the claim names. No listed validation flag covers a disagreement of this kind between a claim and its dependent, so it is recorded here rather than flagged. THE ALKOXIDE PREPARATION is a third transformation this patent performs, and it is not given its own record here. Claim 7 says only that the alkali metal alkoxide is obtained by reacting an alcohol with sodium or potassium metal: no charge, no solvent, no temperature, no isolation, and claim 10, the fully specified process claim, recites the process as two steps. In the worked examples the alkoxide is made, isolated and sealed and does deserve its own record; in the claims it is recited only as the origin of a reagent. A0 also counted two steps for this section. The two metals are therefore carried in compounds[] with role alkoxide_precursor so the information stays recoverable, and they are not reagents of the substitution itself. Order of addition, from claim 7: with an alcohol and a base, the base and the alcohol go into the solvent first and the benzoate salt after; with the alkali metal alkoxide, the alkoxide goes into the solvent first and the benzoate salt after. Claim 9 adds that the salt is charged in batches over a total addition time of 1 to 3 h. Both are in that compound's addition_profile, where the addition time belongs, and not in time_h. Numbers the schema cannot hold: time_h is null because the reaction time is given only as a range; ph_value and workup.ph_target are null because the pH is given as a range, so ph_target_stage names the stage and the range is kept in workup.steps; equivalents are null throughout because every stoichiometry in claims 5 to 8 is a range. The temperature is a range and is recorded in full. Solvent removal is a workup operation, so it sets concentration_method and not a reaction pressure. The product name stays generic: alkoxymethyl leaves the alkyl group unspecified, and claim 5 allows two alcohols, so the claims cover two products without naming either. The Chinese name of the benzoate salt straddles the page break between lines 85 and 90, and the EN convenience line at line 86 is truncated mid-word there; the Chinese is authoritative and complete, so this is a rendering artifact and not a translation conflict.
